function createTaperedBoxGeometry(lengthX, heightY, depthZ, frontScaleY = 0.5, frontScaleZ = 0.5, frontDropY = 0) {
      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(lengthX, heightY, depthZ);
      const pos = geo.attributes.position;
      const halfX = lengthX * 0.5;
      for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
        const vx = pos.getX(i);
        const vy = pos.getY(i);
        const vz = pos.getZ(i);
        if (vx > halfX * 0.2) {
          pos.setY(i, vy * frontScaleY + frontDropY);
          pos.setZ(i, vz * frontScaleZ);
        }
      }
      const nonIndexed = geo.toNonIndexed();
      nonIndexed.computeVertexNormals();
      return nonIndexed;
    }

function createVerticalPrismGeometry(topX, topZ, bottomX, bottomZ, heightY, shearX = 0, shearZ = 0) {
      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, heightY, 1);
      const pos = geo.attributes.position;
      for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
        const vx = pos.getX(i);
        const vy = pos.getY(i);
        const vz = pos.getZ(i);
        if (vy > 0) {
          pos.setX(i, vx * topX + shearX);
          pos.setZ(i, vz * topZ + shearZ);
        } else {
          pos.setX(i, vx * bottomX);
          pos.setZ(i, vz * bottomZ);
        }
      }
      const nonIndexed = geo.toNonIndexed();
      nonIndexed.computeVertexNormals();
      return nonIndexed;
    }

function createCardboardCutoutPlate(points2D, thickness = 0.045, centerGeo = true) {
      const shape = new THREE.Shape();
      points2D.forEach((pt, idx) => {
        if (idx === 0) shape.moveTo(pt[0], pt[1]);
        else shape.lineTo(pt[0], pt[1]);
      });
      shape.closePath();

      const geo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
        depth: thickness,
        bevelEnabled: false
      });
      if (centerGeo) {
        geo.center();
      } else {
        geo.translate(-0.04, 0, -thickness * 0.5);
      }
      const nonIndexed = geo.toNonIndexed();
      nonIndexed.computeVertexNormals();
      return nonIndexed;
    }

function createArticulatedLeg(upperMat, sockMat, hoofMat, dims = {}) {
      const {
        upperW = 0.22,
        upperD = 0.24,
        upperH = 0.42,
        sockW = 0.17,
        sockH = 0.28,
        hoofH = 0.10
      } = dims;

      const legGroup = new THREE.Group();
      const upperGeo = createVerticalPrismGeometry(upperW, upperD, sockW * 1.08, sockW * 1.12, upperH + 0.05);
      legGroup.add(createCardboardPart(upperGeo, upperMat, { pos: [0, -upperH * 0.5 + 0.02, 0] }));

      const sockGeo = createVerticalPrismGeometry(sockW * 1.02, sockW * 1.02, sockW * 0.92, sockW * 0.92, sockH + 0.03);
      legGroup.add(createCardboardPart(sockGeo, sockMat, { pos: [0, -upperH - sockH * 0.5 + 0.01, 0] }));

      const hoofGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(sockW * 1.12, hoofH, sockW * 1.06);
      legGroup.add(createCardboardPart(hoofGeo, hoofMat, { pos: [0.015, -upperH - sockH - hoofH * 0.5 + 0.01, 0] }));

      return legGroup;
    }

function buildFox(customMats = null) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const mBody = customMats ? customMats.body : matFoxBody;
      const mSnout = customMats ? customMats.snout : matFoxSnout;
      const mTip = customMats ? customMats.tip : matCreamWhiteGouache;
      const mSock = customMats ? customMats.sock : matCharcoalGouache;
      const earScale = customMats && customMats.earScale ? customMats.earScale : 1.0;

      const bodyY = 0.68;
      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.32, 0.48, 0.50, 0.92, 0.90, 0.02), mBody, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      const furSpikePts = [[-0.55, 0], [-0.45, 0.11], [-0.35, 0.01], [-0.22, 0.13], [-0.10, 0.01], [0.04, 0.12], [0.16, 0.01], [0.30, 0.11], [0.42, 0.01], [0.54, 0.09], [0.60, 0]];
      const crestGeo = createCardboardCutoutPlate(furSpikePts, 0.035);
      group.add(
        createCardboardPart(crestGeo, mBody, { pos: [0.02, bodyY + 0.25, 0.07], rot: [0.22, 0, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(crestGeo, mBody, { pos: [0.02, bodyY + 0.25, -0.07], rot: [-0.22, 0, 0] })
      );

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.66, bodyY + 0.14, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);

      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.38, 0.44), mBody, { pos: [0.08, 0, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.56, 0.30, 0.34, 0.30, 0.26, -0.04), mSnout, { pos: [0.44, -0.03, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.09, 0.09, 0.09), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.73, -0.05, 0] })
      );

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.03), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.30, 0.04, side * 0.20] }),
          createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.28 * earScale, 0.16 * earScale, 0.06, 0.18, 0.5, 0), mSock, {
            pos: [0.08, 0.26 + (earScale - 1) * 0.12, side * (0.14 + (earScale - 1) * 0.05)],
            rot: [side * 0.22 * earScale, 0, Math.PI * 0.46]
          }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.04, 0.16 * earScale, 0.07 * earScale), matPinkEarGouache, {
            pos: [0.11, 0.24 + (earScale - 1) * 0.10, side * (0.14 + (earScale - 1) * 0.05)],
            rot: [side * 0.22 * earScale, 0, -0.1]
          })
        );
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.62, bodyY + 0.02, 0);
      group.add(tailGroup);
      tailGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.76, 0.28, 0.28, 0.85, 0.85, 0), mBody, { pos: [-0.36, -0.05, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.14] }),
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.26, 0.23, 0.23), mTip, { pos: [-0.82, -0.11, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.14] })
      );

      const legs = [];
      [[0.44, 0.48, 0.15], [0.44, 0.48, -0.15], [-0.44, 0.48, 0.15], [-0.44, 0.48, -0.15]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(mBody, mSock, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.19, upperD: 0.21, upperH: 0.24, sockW: 0.14, sockH: 0.17, hoofH: 0.07
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mBody };
      return group;
    }

function buildDeer() {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const bodyY = 1.06;
      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.28, 0.56, 0.52, 0.92, 0.90, 0.03), matDeerAuburn, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.56, bodyY + 0.14, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.24, 0.24, 0.32, 0.30, 0.62, 0.14, 0), matDeerMane, { pos: [0.06, 0.22, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.46, 0.26, 0.26, 0.55, 0.55, -0.02), matDeerAuburn, { pos: [0.28, 0.52, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.1] }),
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.07, 0.07, 0.08), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.52, 0.50, 0] })
      );

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.045, 0.045, 0.03), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.26, 0.55, side * 0.13] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.20, 0.09, 0.05), matDeerAuburn, { pos: [0.08, 0.58, side * 0.17], rot: [side * 0.4, -side * 0.2, 0.3] })
        );
        const antlerGroup = new THREE.Group();
        antlerGroup.position.set(0.10, 0.64, side * 0.09);
        antlerGroup.rotation.set(side * 0.32, 0, 0.18);
        antlerGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.56, 0.05), matAntlerCream, { pos: [-0.06, 0.26, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.22] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.24, 0.045, 0.045), matAntlerCream, { pos: [0.04, 0.16, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.42] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.24, 0.045, 0.045), matAntlerCream, { pos: [0.0, 0.34, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.52] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.20, 0.045, 0.045), matAntlerCream, { pos: [-0.14, 0.48, side * 0.06], rot: [side * 0.4, 0, -0.4] })
        );
        headGroup.add(antlerGroup);
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.64, bodyY + 0.12, 0);
      tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16, 0.18, 0.14), matCreamWhiteGouache, { pos: [-0.05, -0.02, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.3] }));
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.44, 0.80, 0.16], [0.44, 0.80, -0.16], [-0.44, 0.80, 0.16], [-0.44, 0.80, -0.16]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(matDeerAuburn, matDeerAuburn, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.16, upperD: 0.17, upperH: 0.46, sockW: 0.11, sockH: 0.26, hoofH: 0.08
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: matDeerAuburn };
      return group;
    }

function buildThrumbo() {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const bodyY = 1.32;
      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.58, 0.84, 0.76, 0.96, 0.94, 0.05), matSnowWhiteGouache, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      const manePts = [[-0.4, 0], [-0.25, 0.26], [0, 0.04], [0.22, 0.32], [0.45, 0]];
      const maneGeo = createCardboardCutoutPlate(manePts, 0.06);
      group.add(
        createCardboardPart(maneGeo, matCreamWhiteGouache, { pos: [0.35, bodyY + 0.46, 0.12], rot: [0.25, 0, 0.2] }),
        createCardboardPart(maneGeo, matCreamWhiteGouache, { pos: [0.35, bodyY + 0.46, -0.12], rot: [-0.25, 0, 0.2] })
      );

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.68, bodyY + 0.24, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.34, 0.34, 0.46, 0.44, 0.96, 0.22, 0), matSnowWhiteGouache, { pos: [0.14, 0.38, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.62, 0.38, 0.38, 0.65, 0.65, -0.04), matSnowWhiteGouache, { pos: [0.42, 0.84, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.12] }),
        // Iconic giant curved Thrumbo horn
        createCardboardPart(createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.03, 0.05, 0.14, 0.16, 0.88, 0.26, 0), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.58, 1.32, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.32] })
      );

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.03), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.40, 0.88, side * 0.19] }));
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.78, bodyY + 0.06, 0);
      tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.32, 0.24, 0.24), matSnowWhiteGouache, { pos: [-0.12, -0.04, 0] }));
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.52, 0.94, 0.24], [0.52, 0.94, -0.24], [-0.52, 0.94, 0.24], [-0.52, 0.94, -0.24]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(matSnowWhiteGouache, matCreamWhiteGouache, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.28, upperD: 0.28, upperH: 0.56, sockW: 0.22, sockH: 0.28, hoofH: 0.10
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: matSnowWhiteGouache };
      return group;
    }

function buildBoomalope(isBoomrat = false) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const s = isBoomrat ? 0.52 : 1.0;
      const bodyY = 0.84 * s;
      const mBody = isBoomrat ? matDonkeyDun : matGazelleTan;

      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.18 * s, 0.54 * s, 0.52 * s, 0.90, 0.90, 0), mBody, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      // Glowing Chemfuel Sacs on Back & Flanks
      [[-0.12 * s, bodyY + 0.26 * s, 0.22 * s], [-0.12 * s, bodyY + 0.26 * s, -0.22 * s], [0.16 * s, bodyY + 0.28 * s, 0]].forEach((p, idx) => {
        const sac = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry((idx === 2 ? 0.36 : 0.44) * s, 0.28 * s, 0.24 * s), matBoomSacAmber, { pos: p });
        group.add(sac);
      });

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.56 * s, bodyY + 0.14 * s, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.44 * s, 0.28 * s, 0.28 * s, 0.48, 0.52, -0.02), mBody, { pos: [0.16 * s, 0.04 * s, 0] })
      );

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.045 * s, 0.045 * s, 0.03), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.18 * s, 0.08 * s, side * 0.14 * s] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.05 * s), mBody, { pos: [0.02 * s, 0.20 * s, side * 0.12 * s], rot: [side * 0.25, 0, 0.2] })
        );
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.58 * s, bodyY, 0);
      tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry((isBoomrat ? 0.48 : 0.18) * s, 0.08 * s, 0.08 * s), matPinkEarGouache, { pos: [-0.14 * s, -0.04 * s, 0] }));
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.38 * s, 0.60 * s, 0.16 * s], [0.38 * s, 0.60 * s, -0.16 * s], [-0.38 * s, 0.60 * s, 0.16 * s], [-0.38 * s, 0.60 * s, -0.16 * s]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(mBody, mBody, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.16 * s, upperD: 0.16 * s, upperH: 0.34 * s, sockW: 0.12 * s, sockH: 0.18 * s, hoofH: 0.08 * s
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: matBoomSacAmber };
      return group;
    }

function buildMegasloth() {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const bodyY = 1.02;

        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.56, 0.92, 0.88, 0.82, 0.84, 0.08), matSlothEarth, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.12] })
      );

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.76, bodyY + 0.22, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.54, 0.44, 0.46, 0.72, 0.72, -0.02), matSlothEarth, { pos: [0.18, 0, 0] }),

      );

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();

      tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.68, 0.38, 0.42, 0.45, 0.45, 0), matSlothEarth, { pos: [-0.26, -0.16, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.35] }));
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];

        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: matSlothEarth };
      return group;
    }

function buildInsectoid(isMegaspider = true) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const s = isMegaspider ? 1.05 : 0.78;
      const mChitin = isMegaspider ? matChitinSpider : matChitinOlive;
      const bodyY = 0.56 * s;

      group.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.76 * s, 0.46 * s, 0.64 * s, 0.85, 0.85, 0), mChitin, { pos: [0.18 * s, bodyY, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.84 * s, 0.54 * s, 0.72 * s, 0.65, 0.65, 0), mChitin, { pos: [-0.46 * s, bodyY + 0.06 * s, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.12] })
      );

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.56 * s, bodyY - 0.04 * s, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.36 * s, 0.32 * s, 0.46 * s), mChitin, { pos: [0.12 * s, 0, 0] }));

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          // Scythe mandibles
          createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.46 * s, 0.10 * s, 0.12 * s, 0.2, 0.3, 0), matCharcoalGouache, {
            pos: [0.38 * s, -0.06 * s, side * 0.18 * s],
            rot: [0, side * 0.32, -0.15]
          }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06 * s, 0.06 * s, 0.04 * s), matBoomSacAmber, { pos: [0.24 * s, 0.08 * s, side * 0.22 * s] })
        );
      });

      const legs = [];
      [-0.36, 0.0, 0.34].forEach((lx) => {
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          const legPivot = new THREE.Group();
          legPivot.position.set(lx * s, bodyY, side * 0.32 * s);
          legPivot.add(
            createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.10 * s, 0.44 * s, 0.10 * s), matCharcoalGouache, {
              pos: [0, -0.14 * s, side * 0.22 * s],
              rot: [-side * 0.58, 0, 0]
            })
          );
          group.add(legPivot);
          legs.push(legPivot);
        });
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mChitin };
      return group;
    }

function buildWarg() {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const bodyY = 0.84;
      group.add(
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.76, 0.64, 0.62), matWargSlate, { pos: [0.28, bodyY + 0.06, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.76, 0.50, 0.48, 0.82, 0.82, 0), matWargSlate, { pos: [-0.36, bodyY - 0.02, 0] })
      );

      const spinePts = [[-0.65, 0], [-0.45, 0.24], [-0.25, 0.03], [-0.05, 0.28], [0.15, 0.04], [0.38, 0.32], [0.58, 0]];
      const spineGeo = createCardboardCutoutPlate(spinePts, 0.05);
      group.add(createCardboardPart(spineGeo, matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.04, bodyY + 0.42, 0] }));

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.68, bodyY + 0.18, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.46, 0.44, 0.48), matWargSlate, { pos: [0.10, 0.04, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.42, 0.30, 0.36, 0.78, 0.78, -0.02), matWargSlate, { pos: [0.42, -0.04, 0] })
      );

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          // Glowing red eyes & protruding white fangs
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06, 0.05, 0.03), matCrimsonWattle, { pos: [0.28, 0.10, side * 0.24] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06, 0.16, 0.06), matCreamWhiteGouache, { pos: [0.52, -0.14, side * 0.14], rot: [0, 0, 0.15] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14, 0.22, 0.06), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.02, 0.30, side * 0.18], rot: [side * 0.2, 0, -0.25] })
        );
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.72, bodyY + 0.04, 0);
      tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.56, 0.18, 0.18), matWargSlate, { pos: [-0.24, -0.06, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.22] }));
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.44, 0.58, 0.20], [0.44, 0.58, -0.20], [-0.46, 0.56, 0.18], [-0.46, 0.56, -0.18]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(matWargSlate, matCharcoalGouache, matCreamWhiteGouache, {
          upperW: 0.24, upperD: 0.24, upperH: 0.32, sockW: 0.18, sockH: 0.18, hoofH: 0.08
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: matWargSlate };
      return group;
    }

function buildBear(isPolar = false) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const mFur = isPolar ? matSnowWhiteGouache : matGrizzlyBrown;
      const bodyY = 0.92;

      group.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.88, 0.82, 0.80, 0.96, 0.96, 0.04), mFur, { pos: [0.28, bodyY + 0.04, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.86, 0.76, 0.76, 0.90, 0.90, 0), mFur, { pos: [-0.38, bodyY, 0] })
      );

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.74, bodyY + 0.12, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.48, 0.46, 0.50), mFur, { pos: [0.12, 0, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.34, 0.26, 0.28, 0.75, 0.75, -0.02), mFur, { pos: [0.44, -0.06, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.09, 0.09, 0.11), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.62, -0.03, 0] })
      );

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.03), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [0.28, 0.06, side * 0.24] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12, 0.14, 0.12), mFur, { pos: [0.06, 0.26, side * 0.20] })
        );
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.82, bodyY + 0.08, 0);
      tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16, 0.16, 0.16), mFur, { pos: [-0.04, 0, 0] }));
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.46, 0.58, 0.24], [0.46, 0.58, -0.24], [-0.48, 0.58, 0.24], [-0.48, 0.58, -0.24]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(mFur, mFur, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.28, upperD: 0.28, upperH: 0.32, sockW: 0.24, sockH: 0.18, hoofH: 0.08
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mFur };
      return group;
    }

function buildFeline(variant = 'cougar') {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const mCoat = variant === 'panther' ? matPantherBlack : variant === 'lynx' ? matLynxSpotted : matCougarTawny;
      const isLynx = variant === 'lynx';
      const s = isLynx ? 0.84 : 1.0;
      const bodyY = 0.72 * s;

      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.36 * s, 0.44 * s, 0.44 * s, 0.92, 0.90, 0), mCoat, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.68 * s, bodyY + 0.16 * s, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.38 * s, 0.34 * s, 0.40 * s), mCoat, { pos: [0.08 * s, 0, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.24 * s, 0.20 * s, 0.26 * s), mCoat, { pos: [0.32 * s, -0.05 * s, 0] })
      );

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05 * s, 0.05 * s, 0.03), matBoomSacAmber, { pos: [0.24 * s, 0.04 * s, side * 0.19 * s] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.10 * s, (isLynx ? 0.22 : 0.12) * s, 0.06 * s), isLynx ? matCharcoalGouache : mCoat, {
            pos: [0.04 * s, 0.22 * s, side * 0.15 * s]
          })
        );
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.68 * s, bodyY + 0.04 * s, 0);
      tailGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry((isLynx ? 0.24 : 0.82) * s, 0.12 * s, 0.12 * s), mCoat, {
          pos: [-(isLynx ? 0.12 : 0.38) * s, -0.10 * s, 0],
          rot: [0, 0, 0.28]
        })
      );
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.46 * s, 0.52 * s, 0.15 * s], [0.46 * s, 0.52 * s, -0.15 * s], [-0.46 * s, 0.52 * s, 0.15 * s], [-0.46 * s, 0.52 * s, -0.15 * s]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(mCoat, mCoat, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.18 * s, upperD: 0.18 * s, upperH: 0.28 * s, sockW: 0.14 * s, sockH: 0.17 * s, hoofH: 0.07 * s
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mCoat };
      return group;
    }

function buildShaggyBovid(variant = 'muffalo') {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const mWool = variant === 'muffalo' ? matMuffaloBlue : variant === 'yak' ? matYakShaggy : matGrizzlyBrown;
      const bodyY = 0.96;

      group.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.56, 0.96, 0.92, 0.96, 0.96, 0.06), mWool, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }),
        // Origami hanging wool skirt plates
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.42, 0.34, 0.98), mWool, { pos: [0, bodyY - 0.42, 0] })
      );

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.76, bodyY - 0.04, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.48, 0.52, 0.54), mWool, { pos: [0.16, 0, 0] }));

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.12, 0.38), matAntlerCream, {
            pos: [0.16, 0.14, side * 0.38],
            rot: [side * 0.35, 0, 0.25]
          })
        );
      });

      const legs = [];
      [[0.48, 0.54, 0.26], [0.48, 0.54, -0.26], [-0.48, 0.54, 0.26], [-0.48, 0.54, -0.26]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(mWool, matCharcoalGouache, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.26, upperD: 0.26, upperH: 0.26, sockW: 0.20, sockH: 0.18, hoofH: 0.10
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mWool };
      return group;
    }

function buildRhino() {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const bodyY = 0.98;
      group.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.58, 0.88, 0.84, 0.94, 0.94, 0), matRhinoArmour, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] })
      );

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.78, bodyY - 0.04, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.62, 0.48, 0.48, 0.72, 0.72, -0.06), matRhinoArmour, { pos: [0.24, -0.04, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.16] }),
        // Front & secondary nasal horns
        createCardboardPart(createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.03, 0.03, 0.14, 0.14, 0.44, 0.08, 0), matAntlerCream, { pos: [0.46, 0.26, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.22] }),
        createCardboardPart(createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.03, 0.03, 0.10, 0.10, 0.22, 0.04, 0), matAntlerCream, { pos: [0.28, 0.20, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.15] })
      );

      const legs = [];
      [[0.52, 0.62, 0.26], [0.52, 0.62, -0.26], [-0.52, 0.62, 0.26], [-0.52, 0.62, -0.26]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(matRhinoArmour, matRhinoArmour, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.30, upperD: 0.30, upperH: 0.34, sockW: 0.26, sockH: 0.18, hoofH: 0.10
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: matRhinoArmour };
      return group;
    }

function buildEquine(variant = 'horse') {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const mCoat = variant === 'alpaca' ? matAlpacaWool : variant === 'donkey' ? matDonkeyDun : matEquineBay;
      const s = variant === 'alpaca' ? 0.85 : variant === 'donkey' ? 0.88 : 1.05;
      const bodyY = 1.02 * s;

      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.32 * s, 0.56 * s, 0.54 * s, 0.94, 0.94, 0), mCoat, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.56 * s, bodyY + 0.14 * s, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      const neckH = (variant === 'alpaca' ? 0.78 : 0.58) * s;
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.22 * s, 0.22 * s, 0.30 * s, 0.28 * s, neckH, 0.14 * s, 0), mCoat, { pos: [0.08 * s, neckH * 0.45, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.46 * s, 0.26 * s, 0.26 * s, 0.62, 0.62, -0.02), mCoat, { pos: [0.28 * s, neckH * 0.9, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.18] })
      );

      const earH = variant === 'donkey' ? 0.34 : 0.16;
      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.08 * s, earH * s, 0.06 * s), mCoat, { pos: [0.10 * s, neckH + 0.08 * s, side * 0.11 * s], rot: [side * 0.2, 0, 0.15] })
        );
      });

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.66 * s, bodyY + 0.08 * s, 0);
      tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16 * s, 0.48 * s, 0.16 * s), variant === 'horse' ? matCharcoalGouache : mCoat, { pos: [-0.08 * s, -0.18 * s, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.25] }));
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.44 * s, 0.78 * s, 0.16 * s], [0.44 * s, 0.78 * s, -0.16 * s], [-0.44 * s, 0.78 * s, 0.16 * s], [-0.44 * s, 0.78 * s, -0.16 * s]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(mCoat, mCoat, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.17 * s, upperD: 0.17 * s, upperH: 0.44 * s, sockW: 0.13 * s, sockH: 0.26 * s, hoofH: 0.08 * s
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mCoat };
      return group;
    }

function buildIbexOrBoar(isBoar = false) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const mCoat = isBoar ? matBoarBristle : matDonkeyDun;
      const bodyY = isBoar ? 0.58 : 0.84;

      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(1.06, 0.52, 0.48, 0.92, 0.92, 0), mCoat, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.52, bodyY + (isBoar ? 0.02 : 0.22), 0);
      group.add(headGroup);
      headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.44, 0.30, 0.30, 0.62, 0.62, -0.02), mCoat, { pos: [0.16, 0, 0] }));

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        if (isBoar) {
          // Upturned white tusks
          headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06, 0.18, 0.06), matCreamWhiteGouache, { pos: [0.34, 0.04, side * 0.16], rot: [side * 0.25, 0, -0.3] }));
        } else {
          // Huge sweeping Ibex scimitar horns
          headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.62, 0.09, 0.07), matCharcoalGouache, { pos: [-0.12, 0.32, side * 0.12], rot: [side * 0.22, 0, 0.55] }));
        }
      });

      const legs = [];
      [[0.36, bodyY - 0.18, 0.15], [0.36, bodyY - 0.18, -0.15], [-0.36, bodyY - 0.18, 0.15], [-0.36, bodyY - 0.18, -0.15]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createArticulatedLeg(mCoat, mCoat, matCharcoalGouache, {
          upperW: 0.16, upperD: 0.16, upperH: isBoar ? 0.22 : 0.38, sockW: 0.12, sockH: isBoar ? 0.12 : 0.20, hoofH: 0.07
        });
        leg.position.set(...coord);
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mCoat };
      return group;
    }

function buildBird(variant = 'ostrich') {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const isTall = variant === 'ostrich' || variant === 'emu' || variant === 'cassowary';
      const s = isTall ? 1.0 : 0.58;
      const bodyY = isTall ? 0.98 : 0.46;
      const mPlumage =
        variant === 'ostrich' || variant === 'cassowary'
          ? matPantherBlack
          : variant === 'turkey'
          ? matGrizzlyBrown
          : variant === 'chicken'
          ? matSnowWhiteGouache
          : matDonkeyDun;

      group.add(createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.76 * s, 0.52 * s, 0.54 * s, 0.85, 0.85, 0), mPlumage, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      // Folded origami wings
      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        group.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.56 * s, 0.36 * s, 0.08 * s), mPlumage, { pos: [-0.04 * s, bodyY + 0.04 * s, side * 0.29 * s], rot: [0, side * 0.08, -0.1] }));
      });

      // Turkey spread origami tail fan
      if (variant === 'turkey') {
        const fanPts = [[-0.45, 0], [-0.38, 0.42], [0, 0.54], [0.38, 0.42], [0.45, 0]];
        const fanGeo = createCardboardCutoutPlate(fanPts, 0.04);
        group.add(createCardboardPart(fanGeo, matFoxBody, { pos: [-0.28, bodyY + 0.22, 0], rot: [0, Math.PI * 0.5, 0.25] }));
      }

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.32 * s, bodyY + 0.16 * s, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);

      const neckH = isTall ? 0.72 : 0.24;
      const mNeck = variant === 'cassowary' ? matCassowaryBlue : variant === 'ostrich' ? matPinkEarGouache : mPlumage;
      headGroup.add(
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14 * s, neckH, 0.14 * s), mNeck, { pos: [0.06 * s, neckH * 0.5, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.12] }),
        createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.22 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.18 * s), mNeck, { pos: [0.14 * s, neckH + 0.06, 0] }),
        createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.24 * s, 0.09 * s, 0.12 * s, 0.3, 0.5, 0), matBeakGold, { pos: [0.32 * s, neckH + 0.04, 0] })
      );

      if (variant === 'cassowary' || variant === 'chicken' || variant === 'turkey') {
        headGroup.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18 * s, 0.16 * s, 0.05 * s), variant === 'cassowary' ? matBuffaloHorn : matCrimsonWattle, {
            pos: [0.14 * s, neckH + 0.20, 0]
          })
        );
      }

      const legs = [];
      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        const leg = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.08 * s, bodyY - 0.06, 0.08 * s), matBeakGold, {
          pos: [0.02, (bodyY - 0.06) * 0.5, side * 0.14 * s]
        });
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mPlumage };
      return group;
    }

function buildReptile(variant = 'tortoise') {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      if (variant === 'cobra') {
        // Reared S-curve Origami Cobra with flared hood
        const hoodPts = [[-0.28, -0.3], [-0.36, 0.15], [-0.18, 0.42], [0.18, 0.42], [0.36, 0.15], [0.28, -0.3]];
        const hoodGeo = createCardboardCutoutPlate(hoodPts, 0.05);
        group.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.68, 0.14, 0.58), matReptileGreen, { pos: [-0.12, 0.07, 0] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16, 0.68, 0.16), matReptileGreen, { pos: [0.22, 0.42, 0], rot: [0, 0, -0.15] }),
          createCardboardPart(hoodGeo, matGazelleTan, { pos: [0.24, 0.56, 0], rot: [0, Math.PI * 0.5, -0.15] })
        );
        const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
        headGroup.position.set(0.28, 0.78, 0);
        headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.26, 0.14, 0.22), matReptileGreen, { pos: [0.08, 0, 0] }));
        group.add(headGroup);
        group.userData = { headGroup, legs: [], primaryMaterial: matReptileGreen };
        return group;
      }

      const isTortoise = variant === 'tortoise';
      const mMain = isTortoise ? matTortoiseShell : matReptileGreen;
      const bodyY = 0.32;

      if (isTortoise) {
        group.add(
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.84, 0.36, 0.68), matTortoiseShell, { pos: [0, bodyY + 0.08, 0] }),
          createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.62, 0.22, 0.48), matTortoiseShell, { pos: [0, bodyY + 0.30, 0] })
        );
      } else {
        group.add(
          createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.92, 0.26, 0.32, 0.85, 0.85, 0), matReptileGreen, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }),
          createCardboardPart(createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.78, 0.16, 0.16, 0.2, 0.2, 0), matReptileGreen, { pos: [-0.78, bodyY - 0.04, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.08] })
        );
      }

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.46, bodyY + 0.04, 0);
      headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.28, 0.20, 0.24), matReptileGreen, { pos: [0.12, 0, 0] }));
      group.add(headGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.28, 0.16, 0.26], [0.28, 0.16, -0.26], [-0.28, 0.16, 0.26], [-0.28, 0.16, -0.26]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14, 0.24, 0.14), matReptileGreen, { pos: coord });
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mMain };
      return group;
    }

function buildSmallMammal(variant = 'capybara') {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const mCoat =
        variant === 'chinchilla'
          ? matChinchillaSilver
          : variant === 'raccoon'
          ? matTimberWolfGrey
          : variant === 'squirrel'
          ? matFoxBody
          : matCapybaraBrown;
      const s = variant === 'capybara' ? 0.85 : 0.62;
      const bodyY = 0.44 * s;

      group.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.86 * s, 0.48 * s, 0.48 * s), mCoat, { pos: [0, bodyY, 0] }));

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0.42 * s, bodyY + 0.10 * s, 0);
      headGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.38 * s, 0.34 * s, 0.36 * s), mCoat, { pos: [0.14 * s, 0, 0] }));
      group.add(headGroup);

      const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
      tailGroup.position.set(-0.44 * s, bodyY + 0.08 * s, 0);
      if (variant === 'squirrel' || variant === 'chinchilla' || variant === 'raccoon') {
        tailGroup.add(createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.28 * s, 0.56 * s, 0.26 * s), mCoat, { pos: [-0.14 * s, 0.22 * s, 0], rot: [0, 0, 0.35] }));
      }
      group.add(tailGroup);

      const legs = [];
      [[0.28 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.16 * s], [0.28 * s, 0.18 * s, -0.16 * s], [-0.28 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.16 * s], [-0.28 * s, 0.18 * s, -0.16 * s]].forEach((coord) => {
        const leg = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14 * s, 0.28 * s, 0.14 * s), mCoat, { pos: coord });
        group.add(leg);
        legs.push(leg);
      });

      group.userData = { headGroup, tailGroup, legs, primaryMaterial: mCoat };
      return group;
    }
 const builders=Object.freeze({
"thrumbo":()=>buildThrumbo(),
"boomalope":()=>buildBoomalope(false),
"boomrat":()=>buildBoomalope(true),
"megasloth":()=>buildMegasloth(),
"megaspider":()=>buildInsectoid(true),
"spelopede":()=>buildInsectoid(false),
"warg":()=>buildWarg(),

"polar_bear":()=>buildBear(true),

"panther":()=>buildFeline('panther'),
"lynx":()=>buildFeline('lynx'),
"timber_wolf":()=>buildFox({ body: matTimberWolfGrey, snout: matTimberWolfGrey, tip: matCharcoalGouache, sock: matTimberWolfGrey }),
"fennec":()=>buildFox({ body: matFennecSand, snout: matFennecSand, tip: matCreamWhiteGouache, sock: matFennecSand, earScale: 1.65 }),
"bison":()=>buildShaggyBovid('bison'),
"yak":()=>buildShaggyBovid('yak'),
"rhino":()=>buildRhino(),
"horse":()=>buildEquine('horse'),
"donkey":()=>buildEquine('donkey'),
"alpaca":()=>buildEquine('alpaca'),

"ostrich":()=>buildBird('ostrich'),

"guinea_pig":()=>buildSmallMammal('guinea_pig')
 });
 return Object.freeze({ids:Object.freeze(Object.keys(builders)),materialRecords,
  build(id){if(!Object.hasOwn(builders,id))throw Error('Not an admitted new bestiary reference: '+id);return builders[id]();}
 });
}
